items.issue: Page 92 describes a piecewise 1.6/2.4 correction while page 97 uses 2.4 with a 5.4 mmol/L baseline.
items.applicationAction: Both equations are shown as separate page-labelled calculators

items.issue: Several 60 kg cells are inconsistent with the stated 1 mg/mL concentration and surrounding arithmetic.
items.applicationAction: Calculator derives the rate from the user-confirmed prepared concentration (source: 200 mg in 200 mL = 1 mg/mL); the inconsistent page 106 table cells are not used, and the card warns that they must not be used pending clinical resolution

items.issue: Several cells are inconsistent with the stated 100 mcg/mL concentration.
items.applicationAction: Calculator derives the rate from the user-confirmed prepared concentration (100 mcg/mL); the inconsistent source table cells are not used, and the card warns that the table contains arithmetic discrepancies

items.issue: The label says 20 mg/mL, while 400 mg in 40 mL and the rate table imply 10 mg/mL.
items.applicationAction: Protocol text is shown as printed; the calculator requires entry and confirmation of the actual prepared concentration

items.issue: The heart-rate band appears as 13-139 and threshold wording is inconsistent with surrounding text.
items.applicationAction: Uses the intended 130-139 band but remains marked unreviewed

items.issue: The HJH source includes potassium; the previous app used the no-potassium variant.
items.decision: Label and implement the HJH potassium-inclusive variant.

items.issue: HJH page 54 prints the high-risk age factor as 'Age > 65'. The validated Canadian C-Spine Rule (Stiell et al., JAMA 2001) uses 'Age >= 65 years', so a patient of exactly 65 must be treated as high-risk rather than excluded.
items.decision: Two-person clinical review authorised applying the validated 'Age >= 65 years' threshold.
items.applicationAction: The canonical entry still mirrors the immutable supplied source ('Age > 65'); the validated 'Age >= 65 years' value is applied to the effective runtime record via the reviewed score-corrections overlay (src/clinical/scoreCorrections.ts), preserving the source-mirror invariant.

items.topic: Acute heart failure fluid bolus units
items.issue: Source prints the fluid bolus as '10-20mg/kg'; ml/kg is clearly intended (mg/kg of crystalloid is not a coherent dose).
items.applicationAction: Text shown as printed; a warning is surfaced on the card

items.issue: Source prints the crystalloid bolus as '20mg/kg'; ml/kg is clearly intended.
items.applicationAction: Text shown as printed; a warning is surfaced on the card

items.issue: The structured extraction conflated the oral 20 mg/kg STAT dose with the separate rectal 15-20 mg/kg STAT dose.
items.applicationAction: A reviewed correction preserves oral and rectal doses as separate route-specific statements.

items.issue: The structured entry attributed an Hour-1 management bundle to pages that contain only adult SIRS, qSOFA and SOFA material.
items.applicationAction: Unsupported management steps were removed; only content present on pages 46-47 remains.

items.issue: The e-FAST extraction contained FASTHUGS content from the following page while omitting the image-based e-FAST guide.
items.applicationAction: The e-FAST card is withheld until a faithful source-image implementation is added.

items.issue: Structured and transcription copies of the same RMMCH topics were exposed as separate protocols.
items.applicationAction: Thirteen superseded transcription copies are withheld; the canonical structured entries remain.

items.issue: C-spine injuries and triage were title-only; CT C-spine and CTB rules contained unreadable control-character payloads.
items.applicationAction: The four affected cards are withheld until page-faithful image or structured reconstructions are available.
